mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, home_team AS hometeam, away_team AS awayteam FROM schedule WHERE MONTH(date) = #{month} ORDER BY date, id
SELECT player, avg AS AVG, obp AS OBP, slg AS SLG FROM hitters WHERE team = #{teamName} AND pa > 0 ORDER BY id
SELECT player, g AS G, w AS W, l AS L, ip AS IP, era AS ERA, whip AS WHIP FROM pitchers WHERE team = #{teamName} ORDER BY id
SELECT player, pa, avg, obp, slg FROM hitters WHERE team = #{teamName} AND pa > 0 ORDER BY pa DESC
SELECT player, g, ip, era, whip, sv, hld FROM pitchers WHERE team = #{teamName} ORDER BY ip DESC
SELECT player, pos, gs FROM positions WHERE team = #{teamName} ORDER BY gs DESC
